jamal r: starting a phased enable for ff `model-route-optimizer`. plan 0% -> 2% -> 15% -> 50% with telemetry gates. runbook: https://confluence.redwood/KB/model-route-optimizer
emma l: ack. gates: p95, errors, and routing hit-rate. rollback if p95 +20% for 5m or errors >1.5x.
deploy-bot: job 5123 queued by jamal r. image: rwd/model-route:v20260324. dry-run ok.
jamal r: pin fallback config to v1 so we can revert fast. command: `rwdctl config set routing.fallback v1 --pin`
deploy-bot: ff model-route-optimizer -> 2% applied. cohorts active.
emma l: monitoring — small p99 jitter, p95 flat. starting quick quality eval on sample.
sre-oncall: standing by, set autopause at p95 delta 25% for 3m.
deploy-bot: progressing to 15% after hold period. ff -> 15% applied.
emma l: quality eval shows a 0.8% dip on one prompt group. p95 long-context +10%. still within thresholds but flagged.
jamal r: hold at 15% and investigate the prompt group. do not proceed to 50% yet.
release-bot: rollout status updated: HOLD at 15% pending investigation. link: https://release.redwood/status/5123
emma l: opened ticket #7710 with telemetry and evals. tagging product and SRE.
sre-oncall: will watch overnight. if metrics cross thresholds, we'll run the rollback snippet: `rwdctl ff set model-route-optimizer 0 --reason "auto-hold"`
jamal r: thanks — we'll reconvene tomorrow AM with deeper tests. :eyes:
